audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed as Job's reply to Zophar: sarcastic rebuke of friends' assumed wisdom, appeal to animals/earth/fish, God's sovereignty over breath and nations, and reversal of rulers/counselors.

verses.restored: Job answered and said:

familiar.text: And Job answered and said,

verses.restored: Surely you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.

familiar.text: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.

verses.restored: But I too have a heart like you; I do not fall below you. Who does not know such things as these?

familiar.text: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?

verses.restored: I am a laughingstock to my companion, one who called to the Divine and was answered; a laughingstock, righteous and whole.

familiar.text: I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.

verses.restored: In the thought of one at ease there is contempt for calamity; it is ready for those whose foot slips.

familiar.text: He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.

verses.restored: The tents of destroyers are at ease, and those who provoke the Divine are secure, those who bring a god in their hand.

familiar.text: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly.

verses.restored: But ask the animals, and they will teach you; the birds of the heavens, and they will tell you.

familiar.text: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:

verses.restored: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you; the fish of the sea will recount to you.

familiar.text: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.

verses.restored: Who among all these does not know that the hand of the Eternal has done this?

familiar.text: Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?

verses.restored: In his hand is the life of every living thing and the breath of all human flesh.

familiar.text: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.

verses.restored: Does not the ear test words as the palate tastes food?

familiar.text: Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?

verses.restored: With the aged is wisdom, and length of days is understanding.

familiar.text: With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.

verses.restored: With him are wisdom and strength; counsel and understanding are his.

familiar.text: With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.

verses.restored: Look, he tears down, and it cannot be rebuilt; he shuts over a person, and it cannot be opened.

familiar.text: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.

verses.restored: Look, he withholds waters and they dry up; he sends them out and they overturn the earth.

familiar.text: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.

verses.restored: With him are strength and sound wisdom; the deceived and the deceiver are his.

familiar.text: With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.

verses.restored: He leads counselors away stripped, and judges he makes fools.

familiar.text: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.

verses.restored: He loosens the bond of kings and binds a belt around their waist.

familiar.text: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.

verses.restored: He leads priests away stripped and overthrows the enduring ones.

familiar.text: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.

verses.restored: He removes speech from the trusted and takes away the discernment of elders.

familiar.text: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.

verses.restored: He pours contempt on nobles and loosens the belt of the strong.

familiar.text: He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.

verses.restored: He uncovers deep things from darkness and brings deep shadow to light.

familiar.text: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.

verses.restored: He makes nations great and destroys them; he spreads nations out and leads them away.

familiar.text: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.

verses.restored: He removes the heart of the heads of the people of the earth and makes them wander in a wasteland where there is no way.

familiar.text: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

verses.restored: They grope in darkness without light, and he makes them stagger like a drunkard.

familiar.text: They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.
